description.description: Description explains the role in an operator-facing list.

name.description: Name identifies the role. It is ignored when updating, since the path carries it.

permissions.description: Permissions are the codes the role grants, from GET /api/admin/permissions.

role.description: Role names a seeded or operator-created role; list them with GET /api/admin/roles.

countries.description:
Countries restricts the account to the listed ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 countries. An
empty list leaves it unrestricted, which suits a rail with no country notion.

account.description:
Account is the provider-specific account the payment is collected from or
disbursed to: a mobile number, bank account, card token, or wallet address.
Momobase treats it as opaque and leaves its validation to the selected
provider, through providers.RequestValidator.

amount.description: Amount is the payment amount in the currency's minor unit.

country.description:
Country is the optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 transaction country. Providers that
declare supported countries are only eligible when it is present and matches.

currency.description: Currency is the three-letter currency code.

customer.description: Customer optionally identifies the collection customer.

description.description: Description is optional payment context shown to downstream systems.

metadata.description:
Metadata optionally carries provider-specific payment details, such as a bank
branch code. It reaches the selected provider and is never persisted, so it
cannot become a free-form store of identifiers Momobase would then have to
protect. It is part of the idempotency hash.

payment_method.description:
PaymentMethod identifies the requested payment rail. It is free-form and must
match an active payment route.

recipient.description: Recipient optionally identifies the disbursement recipient.

reference.description: Reference is the application's unique business reference.

scheme.description:
Scheme optionally names the account's provider-specific scheme, such as a
mobile network, bank, or card brand. Like PaymentMethod it is free-form; the
selected provider interprets it and Momobase never matches on it.

email.description: Email is the party's email address.

name.description: Name is the party's display name.

BearerAuth.description: Enter a bearer token using the format: Bearer {token}
